definition: MindMeister is an online mind mapping application that allows its users to visualize, share and present their thoughts via the cloud.
details: MindMeister was launched in 2007 by MeisterLabs GmbH, a German software company founded by Michael Hollauf and Till Vollmer. After 17 years in the market, MindMeister has more than 7 million users who created more than a billion ideas to date.

explainer.lead: MindMeister is an online mind mapping application that lets users visualize, share and present their thoughts via the cloud. It matters as a collaboration tool: launched in 2007, it has more than 7 million users who have created over a billion ideas to date.

tiers.eli5: It is a website where you draw a map of your ideas and share it with others.
tiers.practitioner: Teams use it for cloud-based brainstorming, sharing and presenting mind maps. It is a productivity application rather than an AI system, so AI-specific integration claims are not supported here.
tiers.paperLevel: MindMeister is an online mind mapping application for visualizing, sharing and presenting thoughts via the cloud; it was launched in 2007 by MeisterLabs GmbH, a German software company founded by Michael Hollauf and Till Vollmer.

explainer.example: A project team could build a shared mind map of a launch plan in MindMeister and present it from the cloud during a review.
